text:
QUOTE: Facts and ecosystem signatures always survive. Tiers 3 and 4 accumulate under every stated tier. You can correct a guess; you cannot un-discover a fact.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says tiers 3 and 4 both always accumulate and that facts differ from guesses, but it never says that the distinction between tiers 3 and 4 is deliberately inert, and it names the fact-versus-guess line only implicitly.
